answer: Admission auction. Slots are scarce, priced by bidding. 100 slots open per epoch, bids sealed. Each bid locks 3 epochs. A 2-epoch window burns fake bids. Losers refunded minus 2%; winners pay clearing price. A mesa bid of 60 sets the floor. Doubled demand doubles the price. A dune of bids from one funder is flagged. Cost: 1,000 identities cost 60,000. Doubled demand costs 120,000. Free identities are a relic. Forgery pays market rate.
